color.note: Paper is the working theme, Lamplight the dark one, Print strips tints for browser print (white sheet, black ink, darker line colours).

tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Page background — the registry's paper.

tokens.name: paper-raised
tokens.usage: Tree nodes, cards, the person form's sheet, menus.

tokens.name: paper-sunk
tokens.usage: Input wells, the photo placeholder, zebra rows in the people list.

tokens.name: rule
tokens.usage: Hairlines: dividers, list row separators, a married-in spouse's box. Decorative only — never the sole edge of a control.

tokens.name: rule-strong
tokens.usage: Input and quiet-button borders (≥3:1 on every paper in every theme).

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Names and body text on paper, paper-raised, paper-sunk and every *-soft tint.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Dates, places, hints and metadata on paper, paper-raised, paper-sunk and lineage-soft.

tokens.name: lineage
tokens.usage: The clan line: descent links in the tree, the clan-line parent's field, the clan-line node frame, the primary button. As text on paper, paper-raised or lineage-soft.

tokens.name: lineage-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted ground behind lineage text; the selected row or node.

tokens.name: on-lineage
tokens.usage: Text on a lineage or danger fill (the primary and danger buttons).

tokens.name: gilt
tokens.usage: Founders and generation numerals (“Gen 3”); as text on paper, paper-raised or gilt-soft. Identity, not a state.

tokens.name: gilt-soft
tokens.usage: Ground behind the founding couple's box and gilt text.

tokens.name: spouse
tokens.usage: Marriage: the “=” join and the line between a couple; as text on paper or paper-raised.

tokens.name: living
tokens.usage: The Living status (always with the word); as text on paper or living-soft.

tokens.name: living-soft
tokens.usage: Ground of the Living badge.

tokens.name: warn
tokens.usage: Unplaced people and soft warnings (a reused name); as text on paper or warn-soft. Always with a word.

tokens.name: warn-soft
tokens.usage: Ground of the Unplaced badge and warning notes.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Hard errors — the one enforced rule, “can't be their own ancestor” — and destructive actions. As text on paper, paper-raised or danger-soft.

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Ground of an error note.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring colour (≥3:1 on every paper). Use via the focus-ring shadow.

tokens.name: on-danger
tokens.usage: Text on a danger fill — an alias of on-lineage.

tokens.name: link-hidden
tokens.usage: A hidden second-parent link, drawn dotted, only when the archive toggle includes it.

families.serif: "Source Serif 4", "Source Serif Pro", Georgia, "Times New Roman", serif
families.sans: "Source Sans 3", "Source Sans Pro", "Segoe UI", system-ui, sans-serif

groups.name: Names
groups.note: Serif is for people's names and page titles only — the record's voice.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Page titles; the tree view's heading.

styles.name: name-lg
styles.usage: The person at the top of the detail page and form.

styles.name: name
styles.usage: A tree node or list row name.

styles.name: name-sm
styles.usage: Dense tree depths and printed charts (≥45 mm node).

groups.name: Interface
groups.note: Sans for everything that is not a name.

styles.name: heading
styles.usage: Section headings on detail and form pages.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Raised by mother, in the family's own words.
styles.usage: Everything else: notes, form input text.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Form labels, button text at small size, table headers.

styles.name: overline
styles.usage: Generation marks and badge text; set in capitals.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Label to input; badge padding.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Inside controls and nodes; gap between name and dates.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Between fields in a row; node padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card and sheet padding; between form rows.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Between sibling nodes; between form sections.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Page gutters.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Between page sections.

radius.note: Nearly square — a ledger, not an app store.

tokens.name: radius-0
tokens.usage: Printed chart nodes and rules.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Badges, photos, inputs.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, tree nodes, cards.

shadow.note: Screen only; the Print theme has none.

tokens.name: shadow-sm
tokens.usage: Tree nodes and cards at rest.

tokens.name: shadow-lg
tokens.usage: Menus and the parent picker popover.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus: a 2px paper gap then 2px solid focus colour.

tree.note: Chart geometry for d3-hierarchy layout and the print chart.

tokens.name: node-width
tokens.usage: On-screen width of a single-person node; a couple box is two of these.

tokens.name: node-gap
tokens.usage: Horizontal gap between sibling nodes.

tokens.name: generation-gap
tokens.usage: Vertical distance between generation rows.

tokens.name: print-node-min
tokens.usage: Minimum printed node width for a readable name (4×8 ft sheet ≈ 48 across).

tokens.name: link-width
tokens.usage: Stroke of descent links (lineage) and the marriage join (spouse).
